ha_claude_code:
claude mcp add --transport http xomtra http://homeassistant.local:8000/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer xmt_..."
dk_clone:
git clone --branch "v$VERSION" --depth 1 https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra.git
cd xomtra/deploy/compose
for f in SHA256SUMS "xomtra-$VERSION-images.env"; do
  curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra/releases/download/v$VERSION/$f"
done
dk_verify:
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
for ref in $(grep '_IMAGE=' "xomtra-$VERSION-images.env" | cut -d= -f2-); do
  cosign verify "$ref" \
    --certificate-identity "https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v$VERSION" \
    --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
    > /dev/null && echo "OK  $ref"
done
dk_up:
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
dk_setup: docker compose exec admin xomtra-admin setup-link
dk_ca:
docker compose exec caddy cat /data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt \
  | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
dk_claude_code:
claude mcp add --transport http xomtra https://<server>/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer xmt_..."
dk_upgrade:
cp -p .env ".env.bak-$(date +%F)"
git fetch --depth 1 origin tag "v$VERSION"
git checkout -q "v$VERSION"
for f in SHA256SUMS "xomtra-$VERSION-images.env"; do
  curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/xomtra/xomtra/releases/download/v$VERSION/$f"
done
dk_pull:
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
